## Description
Briefly describe the purpose of this change and the ticket/issue it addresses.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Pipeline optimization / Performance improvement
- [ ] Infrastructure / Configuration update
- [ ] Documentation update

## Verification Checklist
- [ ] Code follows the style guidelines of this repository (Ruff / Black / Pre-commit)
- [ ] Unit & integration tests added or updated to cover changes
- [ ] All CI checks pass locally and in the runner pipeline
- [ ] **Zero hardcoded values:** No static credentials, environment-specific URLs, or hardcoded usernames
- [ ] Documentation updated if relevant
